work.h2a: What we actually do in your

steps.d: Brand, generic and competitor searches get their own campaigns, so each is judged on its own result.
Keywords are grouped by intent and match type, and searches that bring clicks but never a buyer are blocked.
In Shopping the feed is the ad, so titles, attributes and prices are rewritten for how people search.
Strong assets, clear audience signals and accurate conversion data go in, and we check where the spend lands.
Spend shifts to the campaigns that clear break-even on contribution margin, or on cost per qualified lead.
